Market today: The market's in a sour mood, with stocks falling as the 10-year Treasury yield shot back to 5%. This is bad news for your tech and chip names, as higher rates make future earnings less attractive and amplify the pain on margin.

Your holdings: SOXL (-76.13%) and MUU (-61.25%) are bleeding heavily, compounded by their leveraged nature and decay. QQQ (-6.28%) is right at its stop, and SNOW (-13.38%) is close. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield for any signs of stabilization. Also, watch for further developments around Nvidia, given its importance to your chip exposure.

Bottom line: This is a risk-off environment; focus on protecting capital and managing your stops.
plays: QQQ is at 669.8, just below your 670 stop. Respect your stop and consider exiting to prevent further losses.
SOXL and MUU are down significantly (-76.13% and -61.25%). Given the rising yield environment and their decay, seriously consider trimming or exiting to reduce extreme risk.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The current market conditions and your portfolio's exposure warrant caution over new long positions.
